title: Build It, Protect It
tagline: You build real things this year, and you learn how to protect them.

lessons.title: Welcome to the Workshop
lessons.coverNote: This is the class's first-ever visit to the website, so the one-off Google permission screens land in this hour and they are far easier with the class's own teacher walking pupils through them. If cover cannot be avoided, printed credential slips (school office) should be to hand as a backup for pupils whose logins fail.

lessons.title: Translation Bureau
lessons.tagline: A bureau is an office where things are written out again in another language. Today you turn blocks you already know into your first lines of Python.

lessons.title: Chatbot Workshop
lessons.tagline: You write a program that asks a question and answers you back.

lessons.title: Adventure Engine
lessons.tagline: You make your program choose what happens next.

lessons.title: Loop Machines
lessons.tagline: You get the computer to repeat a job for you, and you draw with it.

lessons.title: Festival Planner
lessons.tagline: You build a spreadsheet that works the answers out for you.

lessons.title: Chart Crimes
lessons.tagline: You learn how a chart can tell the truth, and how one can mislead you.

lessons.title: The Bake Sale Mystery
lessons.tagline: You sort messy information into a database that makes sense.

lessons.title: Query Quest
lessons.tagline: You ask a database questions and get back exactly the answers you need.

lessons.title: Outbreak
lessons.tagline: You find out how malware spreads between computers, and how it is stopped.

lessons.title: Cipher School
lessons.tagline: You hide a message in code, then break somebody else's.

lessons.title: The Courtroom
lessons.tagline: You meet the real UK laws about computers, and see how they are used.

lessons.title: Con Artist Files
lessons.tagline: You learn to spot the tricks people use to con others online.
lessons.coverNote: Most of this hour is class discussion, which is much harder to lead without knowing the class. If cover cannot be avoided, the on-screen work stands on its own and the discussion can be picked up next lesson.

lessons.title: Skeleton Crew
lessons.tagline: You build the skeleton of a real web page in HTML.

lessons.title: Style Salon
lessons.tagline: You style your web page with CSS until it looks the way you want it.

lessons.title: Launch Day
lessons.tagline: You finish your site, publish it for your class and find out what they think of it.

lessons.title: Real or Rendered?
lessons.tagline: You work out what is real online, now that a video or a voice can be faked.
lessons.coverNote: This hour is built around a whole-class discussion about faked video and audio. If cover cannot be avoided, the on-screen work stands on its own and the discussion can be picked up next lesson.
